title: Ad Studio
tagline: Pick a format, point at the product, and Vesper writes the ad around it.

intake.label: Who is it for?
intake.placeholder: new runners, small coffee shops, first-time founders

intake.label: What should they do?
intake.placeholder: Shop the drop, 20% off this week, download the app

formats.title: Product showcase
formats.blurb: The product doing its one job, close enough to read. Hook, proof, a clean last frame.
formats.note: Hold the product to its photos: it is attached to this turn or one of their product elements. If no photo of it is in the conversation, ask for one before writing -- an ad of an invented product does not match the real one.

formats.title: UGC review
formats.blurb: Looks shot on a phone by a real customer: handheld, natural light, a real room.
formats.note: Hold the product to its photos: it is attached to this turn or one of their product elements. If no photo of it is in the conversation, ask for one before writing -- an ad of an invented product does not match the real one. The person on camera is a stand-in customer: never a real, named person.

formats.title: Unboxing
formats.blurb: Hands, a box and the first look at the product, the way a customer would film it.
formats.note: Hold the product to its photos: it is attached to this turn or one of their product elements. If no photo of it is in the conversation, ask for one before writing -- an ad of an invented product does not match the real one. The box is shown as plain packaging unless their photos show the real one.

formats.title: TV spot
formats.blurb: A polished multi-shot commercial with a kit end card. Widescreen first.
formats.note: Hold the product to its photos: it is attached to this turn or one of their product elements. If no photo of it is in the conversation, ask for one before writing -- an ad of an invented product does not match the real one. Write it as timed shots; the brand kit's end card closes the final cut.

formats.title: Motion ad
formats.blurb: Big type, brand colours and the product's own screens on cards, with a voiceover. No filmed footage.
formats.note: This format is built from the brand kit: its colours, type, logo and the product's own screens. When they ask for it to be made, use make_ad. With no kit in play, say so in one line and point them to reading their website into a kit on the Brand page.

formats.title: Product still
formats.blurb: A packshot or hero frame of the real product, drawn from its own photos.
formats.note: Hold the product to its photos: it is attached to this turn or one of their product elements. If no photo of it is in the conversation, ask for one before writing -- an ad of an invented product does not match the real one. It is ONE still: when they ask for it, make_image.

formats.title: Social cut-down
formats.blurb: An ad you already made, re-shaped and shortened for each platform. Free: nothing is re-rendered.
formats.note: This works on an ad they already made: re-shape it with reformat and shorten it with trim_clip, both free. If no clip is in the conversation, ask them to attach it from the Library first. Nothing is re-rendered.
